conf.description: FireEye EX ex-alert CEF notification feed: header split + label-indirected cs1/cs4 decode (falls back to positional if no Label pair present) mapping email extensions into email.* ECS, keep _raw per no-masking direct-route decision.

conf.comment: fireeye / ex-alert / syslog-cef. Single-line CEF alternative to the JSON feed (mutually exclusive Format selection on the notification channel). One attachment hash (MD5) and no per-attachment array on this transport -- headline attachment only. Per recommendations.direct.cribl: suser/duser/msg/fname/fileHash map into the email.* namespace, cs1(sname)/cs4(link) map to rule.name/event.reference -- read via their *Label companion when present (mirrors the nx-alert CEF pipeline's slot-drift defense) else the fixed cs1/cs4 slot the recommendation names. act is mapped to allowed/denied while the raw token is retained on fireeye.ex.action_raw since quarantined is admin-recoverable and that nuance is lost in ECS event.type. Severity is read from the CEF header (numeric 0-10), not the minr/majr/crit token scale. Keeps _raw.

functions.description: split the 8 pipe-delimited CEF header fields (tolerates a leading syslog envelope since the pattern isn't anchored)

tokenize the extension blob (space-lookahead split, tolerant of embedded spaces in request), map flat email keys, resolve cs1/cs4 via Label pairs with positional fallback, action lookup with raw retention, header severity/name/dataset/category tags, cleanup
